programme.title: Locked On SEC
programme.desc: Chris Gordy hosts Locked On SEC, a daily podcast dedicated to bringing SEC fans the most up-to-date info when it comes to Southeastern Conference sports. The Locked On SEC podcast brings you interviews, analysis and match-up breakdowns heading into every week of games. If you're a fan of any school in the conference, it's a show that you do not want to miss. It's the Locked on SEC Podcast, part of the Locked On Podcast Network.

programme.title: Locked On Big 10
programme.desc:
The Locked On Big 10 podcast is your premier destination for daily content focused on one of the deepest, most prestigious conferences in all of the country. Host Craig Shemon takes you all around the conference: the biggest games, stories, and athletes in an authentic, personable manner that will make you a part of the Big 10 community. Hear from some of the conference's biggest experts and insiders that know your school inside and out.
Part of the Locked On Podcast Network.

programme.title: Locked On College Sports
programme.desc:
Keep up with the Power Five conferences. Locked On College Sports delivers the latest episodes of Locked On SEC, Locked On Big 10, Locked On Big 12, Locked On ACC and Locked On Pac-12.
Part of the Locked On Podcast Network. Your team, every day.

programme.title: Locked On ACC
programme.desc:
Candace Cooper & Kenton Gibbs bring you Locked On ACC to talk all things Atlantic Coast Conference! Whether you're in Chapel Hill, Durham, Coral Gables, or anywhere in between, we'll take a different look at ACC sports, without the screaming or hot takes.
Part of the Locked On Podcast Network.

programme.title: Locked On Big 12
programme.desc:
Locked On Big 12 is THE daily podcast dedicated to Big 12 teams, hosted by Baylor graduate and ESPN Central Texas personality Drake C. Toll. Locked On Big 12 is built the Heartland way and will give you the excitement you expect from America's most dynamic conference.
Part of the Locked On Podcast Network.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 9 - Unlocking Better Brain Health
programme.desc: Lesley Visser joins nutritionist Mike Roussell and NFL Hall of Famer Mike Singletary to explore Neutein, cognitive-health research and why brain wellness has become personal for many users.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 4 - Forged in Freedom, Built in America
programme.desc: In this episode of Wild Shots, Tim Harmsen heads to the heart of American gun craftsmanship with an exclusive, behind-the-scenes tour of Palmetto State Armory, where freedom is literally built on the production floor. From the anodizing line to live assembly, Tim witnesses American ingenuity in action as a rifle comes to life before his eyes. With the epic 10,000-Round Challenge complete, it’s time for some serious maintenance. The crew at SEAL 1 steps in with their cutting-edge nanotechnology to give the battle-worn BCM AK the deep clean it deserves. Once the guns are gleaming, it’s time to send rounds downrange. Teaming up with top firearms influencer Sootch, Tim takes aim at a new challenge, including a 1,000-yard Wild Shot that pushes precision, patience, and performance to the limit.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 5 - Microns, Myths, and Machine Guns
programme.desc: This episode of Wildshots kicks off in South Carolina, where Tim Harmsen goes behind the scenes at Jacob Grey Firearms for an inside look at precision craftsmanship in action. Known for their stunning 2011 pistols—true works of art—Jacob Grey takes perfection to the micron. From raw metal to “The Hex,” Tim witnesses how engineering meets artistry to create one of America’s most elite handguns.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 3 - Welcome the Pain
programme.desc: Back by unpopular demand, the infamous “Blah Line” returns—and it’s more brutal than ever. The contestants kick off the day with a hellish PT session that leaves bodies broken and spirits tested. Things only get rougher from there with a punishing stealth crawl over jagged rocks, grinding them down before they face Ken Shamrock’s infamous Lion’s Den training—a relentless gauntlet of pain, grit, and raw endurance. As Don Mann continues to forge a battle-ready team, the squad is thrown into breaching drills designed for high-stakes mission execution. It’s chaos, it’s calculated, and it separates the contenders from the pretenders. In the heat of the action, two standouts emerge from the ranks—earning the coveted role of designated breachers.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 - Ep. 1 - Let The Games Begin
programme.desc: The best of the best are back to compete, and Don’s serving up a heaping plate of his signature 10-part PRT. A bear crawl down a mountain, log running and two-point planks are just some of Don’s welcome gauntlet. And the cherry on top—a 5k desert run. But the contestants only have themselves to blame. Because when you’re already amongst the elite, you have to do whatever it takes to find the one who stands above the rest.

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash).

programme.title: State Property 2
programme.desc: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone.

programme.title: American Violet
programme.desc: After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts (Nicole Beharie) must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. Despite her mother's (Alfre Woodard) advice and risking everything, innocent Dee chooses to fight the Texas criminal justice system, joined by an ACLU attorney (Tim Blake Nelson) and a former narcotics cop (Will Patton).

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Final Shot: The Hank Gathers Story
programme.desc: Inspired by his mother (Nell Carter) and a priest (George Kennedy) in Philadelphia, he (Victor Love) rises to basketball All-American at Loyola Marymount.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

programme.title: The Last Letter
programme.desc: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake.

programme.title: State Property

Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash).

programme.title: April (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: aster, a time of babies, easter eggs are everywhere as birds get busy breeding, lambs dance around fields and cute baby bunnies emerge from their borrows. Migrants like ospreys and puffins return to their breeding sites. Migrants can come in all shapes and sizes and for different reasons. Hammerhead sharks swarm around Galapagos and take advantage of cleaning services on the reef.

programme.title: Marine Mammals - Born to Swim
programme.desc: Every year some 15 million of us around the world cram onto little boats and head out onto the ocean, hoping for the encounter of a lifetime. For centuries whales and dolphins seem to have reached out to us, capturing our imaginations and our souls. Despite their popularity, much of their lives remain a mystery, taking place beneath the waves and beyond our reach.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: It's a miracle the first seafarers ever found the Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani scattered across two million square kilometres of the Pacific Ocean. But every year, these tropical islands become the destination for over three thousand Humpback whales who've undertaken one of the longest migrations on the planet. They come here to socialise, mate, and raise their young.

programme.title: The Power Of Plants - Race to Grow and Breed
programme.desc: Just like animals, the lives of plants are dominated by the need to become strong and pass on genes to the next generation - a race to grow and breed. They must race to beat their competition to the best light spots, and to make the most of perilously short seasons. And also like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Rhino horn is very expensive in the illegal market and the poachers know it. Kaziranga has the only concentrated population of the one horned Rhino in the world. And poachers are attracted to Kaziranga like ants are to sugar. The primary work of the forest department here is to then protect the rhino from the poachers and save the horn. We meet forest guard Shanti Ram Chetri who after 33 years of glorious service retires.

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs. Most animals will defend themselves against predators, but many also do battle with members of the same species. Animals fight for two main reasons: for a mate or to defend their young or territory. And when animals fight, it can often be to the death.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Hunting has been a long-standing cultural tradition in the North Eastern India for long. But with the shirking of the forests and endangering of the wildlife, hunting has become unsustainable. But it is not that this has stopped hunting. The architects of Pakke, a 800 sq Kms forest reserve, in the heart of the hunting villages has done a wonderful job of giving protection to the several endemic species here by keeping the forest safe from the hunters.

programme.title: Animals of Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Thanksgiving. A most treasured holiday, and not just in the USA; it continues to be celebrated across the world in many different guises. These traditions are all united by a celebration of the harvest and the generosity of the natural world. Many animals have weird and wonderful connections to the holidays. Turkeys are one of the most iconic characters, but deer, lobsters and even eagles are also part of the feast.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying just off the coast of west Scotland, the Hebrides archipelago is made up of more than 500 islands and islets. Isolation from the mainland has made it the perfect breeding ground for millions of creatures, making it home to some of the largest gatherings, and greatest spectacles on the planet.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: The Royal Bengal Tiger is in it's most primeval form here in the Sunderbans. `The tangled mangroves along the tributaries of the river Ganga are one of the most fearsome forests of the World. The tigers could kill humans and eat them. The people living around the forests are also one of the poorest in the country. They have to go inside the forest to eke out a living by catching crabs and fish. And that's the opportunity the tiger may seek.

programme.title: Wild Indochinas - Wild heart
programme.desc: Indochina; three ancient kingdoms, Laos, Vietnam and Cambodia, linked by one great river: the mighty Mekong. A mystical land shaped by the forces of the monsoon. A region ravaged by war but, like a Phoenix, risen from the ashes. Within its boundaries can be found one tenth of the world's species, and some of the richest ecosystems on the planet. This is the land of the Mother River, one of the most bio diverse regions on Earth.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Bred from wolves, Huskies have helped humans carve out an existence in Alaska's desolate wilderness. These dogs still maintain many physical adaptations of their wild ancestors, enabling them to withstand the fierce conditions of the Alaskan winter. And in Alaska's most extreme terrain, sled dogs are still the only form of transport. In the south, the modern city of Anchorage is still home to the start of the World's Toughest Race, a 1000 mile sled-dog race, known as the Iditarod.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: On the savannah of southern Africa, rains have turned the land green and lush. It's the time of plenty and for the cast of wild characters here, cashing in is priority number one. From polecat to aardwolf, some of the continent's most seldom seen creatures are out to make the most of the abundance. Some families gorge on the plentiful grasses, while for others there's no such thing as an easy meal, even at this time of year.

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving - but though always on the move they're not exactly speedy.

programme.title: Seals - Clowns of the Sea
programme.desc: Much loved clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Even though they're not much more than bloated sausages on land, they're agile hunters and supremely graceful in the water. They en-tertain us with dramatic courtships, an endlessly playful sense of curiosity and some of the cutest babies on the planet.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Deep in the Southern Ocean, the Snares islands are one of the most pristine island wildernesses left on the planet. Every summer, millions of seabirds converge here to breed. More than 50,000 endemic Snares crested penguins battle massive Southern Ocean swells to come ashore. Deep in the forest they find their mates and raise their chicks in a frantic race to take advantage of the short subantarctic summer.

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, heaviest, fastest, slowest - even the rarest. The creatures that hold the records for these categories are some of the most interesting in the natural world. Some are familiar and iconic, but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers. These quirky and unusual animals that often go ignored are inventive, ingenious and awe-inspiring.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates five different locations along one of the most haunted streets in America! Main Street in St. Charles, Missouri was built on top of a cemetery, which at one time housed hundreds of bodies. As St. Charles grew, it became inconvenient to have a cemetery in the middle of the city and in 1850 it was decided that bodies should be moved to another area. However, not all of them were removed and buildings were constructed over them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Carthage, Missouri to investigate the Burlingame & Chaffee Opera House. The building has multiple floors and has had various uses over the decades, starting in 1878 when the second floor was an Opera House, the lower level, a hardware store and the basement a mortuary. In the early 1900's the building was sold to Charles E. Turner who owned a carriage and harness company.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Joplin, Missouri to investigate the Holly Hill Estate. The property is comprised of two houses with very different histories. The first house is called Willow Vista, which was built in 1916 and was a private club with ties to the mob. Over the years it was also believed to have been a speakeasy and a brothel. In 1958, a doctor named Donald Patterson bought the Willa Vista and made it into a family home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stay close to home as they investigate two neighboring buildings: Stadium Theatre and Stadium Building in Woonsocket, Rhode Island. Original owner, Arthur Darman constructed the building and the theatre in 1926. His vision for the theatre was to bring live entertainment to those who couldn't afford to travel to New York. The adjacent building was a community hub, which featured doctors' offices, law firms, dentists, and insurance agencies.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lawrenceburg, Kentucky to investigate The Wild Turkey Distillery. Guest investigator, Kristen Luman, as well as two familiar faces, Dustin and KJ join the team. The descendent of the founding family, Olivia Ripy, calls the team in to investigate. Her family started making whiskey as far back as 1869 and in 1935, her grandparents went into business as the Ripy Brothers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hyde Park, New York to investigate the Culinary Institute of America. Built in the early 1900's the building was originally a seminary for young men looking to become Jesuit priests. It was shut down in 1969 due to diminishing enrollment. The Culinary Institute took over the building two years later.
programme.sub-title: Too Many Apparaitions in the Kitchen

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home on this investigation as they travel to Newport, Rhode Island to investigate Fort Adams, the largest coastal fortress ever constructed on US soil. This is the second fort built on the site. The original structure was built in 1799 and stood through 1812. The fort was rebuilt from 1824-1857 and could hold 468 cannons, where as the first could only hold 20. Many deaths were reported but had nothing to do with battle but rather, murder, suicide, and illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Bennington, Vermont to investigate Southern Vermont College. Edward Everett was a wealthy man who built his mansion on these grounds between 1911-1914. He was married twice and had 5 children. When he died in 1929 his estimated worth was between $40-$50 million. The legend that students have passed down through the years is that Edward's first wife, Amy, committed suicide, and didn't die of poor health, which was reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the Conrad-Caldwell Castle, the masterpiece built by well-known architect, Arthur Loomis. The house took 3 years to complete and was the symbol of success for the original owner, Theophilus Conrad and his wife, who started out as poor immigrants before working their way up to being wealthy industrialists. The couple lived in this home for ten years, before Mr. Conrad died of a heart attack on the basement stairs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Lenox, Massachusetts to investigate The Mount, a location they first visited in 2008. Built in 1902, the Mount was designed and built for Pulitzer Prize winning author, Edith Wharton and her husband, Teddy. When their marriage started to fall apart in 1911, the couple moved out and eventually divorced. This renowned property is where Edith wrote many of her best sellers, and had famous friends visit, including Henry James.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Boston, Massachusetts to investigate the USS Constitution, the oldest commissioned warship still afloat in the world and one that also never lost a battle. She was built in 1794 and decommissioned in 1855, then placed in permanent commission in 1940. Today she holds a crew of 60, but at a peak time, during the War of 1812, she had 450-500 people aboard: including 60 marines, 350-400 sailors, and 50 officers/ship boys.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to North Adams, Massachusetts to investigate Houghton Mansion. It was built in 1897 for North Adams' first Mayor, A.C Houghton. Constructed on the foundation of a previous home, The Houghton Mansion was used for the family and fundraisers. The hauntings are said to have begun in 1914 after a tragic car accident took the lives of A.C Houghton and his daughter. His chauffer was driving and was so overcome with guilt that he took his own life the next day. A week later Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Glen Spey, New York to investigate Burn Brae Mansion, which was formerly the summer home of Margaret and Charles Elkin. It was constructed in the early 1900's by Margaret, who was one of seven MacKenzie siblings to build a grand estate in Glen Spey with the money given to her by her father. Several of Charles and Margaret's children passed away young, and their coachman, William attempted suicide on the property, and later died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out by two clients to investigate the Midwest Railway Preservation Society in Cleveland, Ohio. Built in 1907, this rail yard had over 400 people working there 24/7. Some of the jobs were very dangerous with a number of injuries and deaths taking place over the years, with the brakeman being one of the most dangerous. Sometimes people fell off the tops of the trains and died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the season premiere of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cleveland, Ohio to investigate Grays Armory. It was built in 1893 to house the men's only Grays militia force, a force that was to protect the city of Cleveland from any unrest, as there was no National Guard at that point in time. The gray color was chosen to honor the New York grey's for being victorious during the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Detroit, Michigan to investigate The Whitney. Originally built in 1890 by lumber baron David Whitney, it was used as a private residence for him and his second wife, Sarah, along with his four children. At the time the house was built he was the wealthiest man in Detroit, and spared no expense in his home, including adding the first personal use elevator, and $400,000 worth of furnishings from two trips to Europe. Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Toledo, Ohio to investigate the Toledo Yacht Club. Susan Hurst has called the guys in to investigate the club, which first opened in 1865. A fire destroyed it in 1906 and it was rebuilt in 1908. It became well known during the prohibition era, as bootleggers used the docks to smuggle Canadian booze across Lake Erie.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn't take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What's that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto visita a Ignacio y le pide ayuda para salir del país. Mónica le dispara a Irina para evitar que huya de México. Chema quiere obtener ADN de Aurelio para compararlo con el del cadáver.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto le confiesa a Ximena que se va a Europa para salirse del mundo de la droga. Elsa elige lanzarse como candidata, en lugar de aceptar un puesto en el gabinete presidencial.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor es llevada a juicio, y aunque Ignacio maneja su defensa, la condenan a 15 años. Mientras, Pedro busca el apoyo de Max y Elsa el de Chema durante la campaña para la gubernatura de Jalisco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio toma al Cabo como rehén y viaja a Colombia, donde toma venganza matando a su hijo. Luego se interna con Mónica en la selva colombiana, él con el nombre de Francisco, ella como Dolores.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio cesa los envíos a Chacorta tras los ataques a las Torres Gemelas, y busca nuevas rutas para pasar la droga. Al campamento llega un infiltrado del Tostado, listo para hacer daño.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leo se debate entre escapar con una compañera de prisión o quedarse y confiar en que Ignacio la libere por vías legales. Mónica le dice a Aurelio que quiere tener un hijo suyo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El general Montoya descubre la verdadera identidad de Francisco, y le pone precio a su silencio. Tras varios años de ausencia, Heriberto regresa a casa y Chacorta lo visita.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chema quiere ir a Colombia para descubrir la identidad del mexicano que se está inmiscuyendo en su negocio, y Leonor busca la ayuda del coronel Ramos para liberar a Ponte de la cárcel.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ignacio ofrece casarse con Leonor para que no la deporten. Chacorta le ofrece a Matilde un trato que no puede rechazar. Aurelio amenaza a Gildardo con desmembrarlo si no dice la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica le dice a Aurelio que está embarazada, y él quiere construir un laboratorio en territorio venezolano. Chacorta hace una oferta de negocio a Pepe Johnson para vender cocaína por su cuenta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto quiere vengarse de Ignacio. Chema busca la ayuda de Elsa para conseguir que Tijeras salga de la cárcel. Heriberto toma una decisión que cambia su vida: dejar el negocio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Lay confiesa su eterno amor por Aurelio, viaja a Colombia y pone en riesgo su vida para verlo. En un intento desesperado por no ser deportada, Leonor acepta casarse con Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica está lista para matar a Lay: Ella revela que fue Tijeras quien orquestó el ataque, y deben escapar juntas. Ximena cubre a Heriberto cuando Chacorta llega a la casa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de la emboscada, Mauricio se siente traicionado y quiere venganza. Aurelio, Mónica y Lay llegan a México. Santiago viaja a solas con Ximena y le propone matrimonio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras acusarla de darle pistas falsas sobre Aurelio, el Chema le pide a Matilde información sobre Chacorta. Leonor quiere que Victoria la ayude a encontrar a Ximena.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema amenaza a Mónica para que lo ponga en contacto con Francisco, sin saber que hablan del propio Aurelio. Ella le revela que está embarazada para que dejen de golpearla.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio denuncia al Chema con la Interpol, en un intento desesperado por rescatar a Mónica. Leonor comienza a seguir a Ximena, mientras Ignacio y Victoria le ayudan a conseguir información.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de una balacera con agentes de Interpol, la DEA captura al Chema, quien intenta sobornarlos. Santiago le sugiere que Heriberto se entregue para proteger a Ximena.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor le exige a Ximena que entregue a Aurelio y, a cambio, le propone dejar en paz a Heriberto. Lay busca asociarse con Iñaqui para operar el tráfico de drogas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

Gabi contrató a un chico para que fingiera ser su novio en la fiesta de su graduación, pero el chico no imaginaba que iba a participar en una competencia de chupetones en el cuello, y mucho menos que unos días más tarde estaría muerto por causa de ese chupetón.
programme.sub-title: Las pájaras no tenemos hijos; La chupetona

programme.title: Caso cerrado
